themes_detail.label: Pool/Beach facility crisis
themes_detail.summary: Beach/Pool/Sauna complaints spiked to 3 this week vs. 0.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (1100% increase, z-score: 4.16)—signaling potential facility closures, water quality issues, or access problems in a district with limited public pool infrastructure during summer season.
evidence: 3 Beach/Pool/Sauna complaints filed this week vs. 0.2 weekly baseline (1100% spike, z-score: 4.16)
Greenwich Village/SoHo has historically limited public aquatic facilities
Timing coincides with peak summer usage and heat-relief demand
reporting_angles: Contact NYC Parks to identify which facility triggered complaints and current operational status
Interview residents about access to public pools during heat wave season in a dense neighborhood

themes_detail.label: Panhandling surge last week
themes_detail.summary: Panhandling complaints jumped to 18 last week vs. 3.9 weekly average (364% increase, z-score: 4.62)—a sharp one-week spike suggesting either a discrete event, enforcement gap, or emerging encampment activity in a commercial corridor.
evidence: 18 panhandling complaints last week vs. 3.9 weekly baseline (364% spike, z-score: 4.62)
This is the largest single-week jump in the dataset
No sustained trend—appears acute and potentially reversible
reporting_angles: Map complaint locations to determine if concentrated in Washington Square Park, commercial strips (Broadway, Spring St.), or transit hubs
Interview local business owners and BID representatives about visible encampments or enforcement actions
Cross-reference with NYPD enforcement activity and homeless services data

themes_detail.label: Root/sewer infrastructure failure
themes_detail.summary: Root/Sewer/Sidewalk condition complaints exploded to 4 two weeks ago vs. 0.2 weekly average (1500% increase, z-score: 8.66, highest in dataset)—indicating a critical subsurface infrastructure failure, likely tree root invasion or main line rupture affecting multiple properties.
evidence: 4 Root/Sewer/Sidewalk complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.2 weekly baseline (1500% spike, highest z-score: 8.66)
Spike occurred 2 weeks ago; current status unclear from data
Community board historically requests 'Clean catch basins'—recurring unfunded need
reporting_angles: Contact DEP to identify which streets/blocks filed complaints and whether emergency work was ordered
Interview affected residents about water intrusion, backup, or sidewalk collapses
Investigate whether aging Village/SoHo sewer lines are systematically undersized for modern demand + tree canopy pressure

themes_detail.label: Asbestos exposure reports spike
themes_detail.summary: Asbestos complaints surged to 3 two weeks ago vs. 0.2 weekly average (1100% increase, z-score: 6.35)—a critical public health signal likely tied to building renovation permits (1,415 alteration permits filed in past 90 days) and potential improper abatement during renovation work.
evidence: 3 asbestos complaints filed 2 weeks ago vs. 0.2 weekly baseline (1100% spike, z-score: 6.35)
1,415 alteration permits and 121 Alteration COs issued in past 90 days—high renovation activity tied to asbestos risk
Building/Use complaints also spiked (38 complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 3.2 avg)—possible convergence
reporting_angles: Cross-reference asbestos complaints with specific alteration permit addresses to identify problem buildings/contractors
Investigate whether DEP and DOB are coordinating asbestos notification and abatement oversight during renovations
Interview residents about exposure symptoms and whether contractors disclosed asbestos presence before work began

themes_detail.label: Building code/use violations cluster
themes_detail.summary: Building/Use complaints spiked to 38 three weeks ago vs. 3.2 weekly average (1069% increase, z-score: 6.1)—a one-time surge suggesting either a code enforcement sweep, a major building conversion/illegally occupied space, or multiple violations discovered simultaneously.
evidence: 38 Building/Use complaints filed 3 weeks ago vs. 3.2 weekly baseline (1069% spike, z-score: 6.1)
1,415 alteration permits filed in past 90 days suggest active renovation/conversion activity
246 Spring Street ULURP completed; other rezonings may be driving conversion to incompatible uses
reporting_angles: Retrieve DOB violation database to identify the 38 specific buildings cited 3 weeks ago and violation types
Interview DOB about whether enforcement action or complaint wave was triggered by a particular event (e.g., conversion wave)
Investigate whether illegal short-term rentals or co-living conversions are driving use violations
